title: Grateful Dead Live at The Ark on 1969-04-23
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: Excellent Charlie Miller soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1969 Ark show featuring a smoking Dark Star, Morning Dew and a standout Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks).
ai_review.review: This recording is praised as an audio masterpiece, with a crisp, clean soundboard mix that lets the band’s 1969 fire shine through. The performance dazzles from a quiet “He Was A Friend Of Mine” opener into a monster Dark Star, a long‑awaited Morning Dew and several ripping jams (The Eleven, Alligator > Drums > Jam, Caution). Reviewers consistently note the high energy, tight playing and superb transfer by Charlie Miller.

ai_rating.rationale: The show is repeatedly described as one of the best of ’69 with many standout songs and high energy, while the recording is called an excellent soundboard transfer; both factors push the rating into the top tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean mix praised as a Charlie Miller “audio masterpiece”; minor splice/cut noted in St. Stephen but does not detract from overall clarity.

standout_songs: He Was A Friend Of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: Starts with a quiet, beautiful folk opener and steadily builds intensity through extended jams and seamless segues, delivering a varied yet cohesive experience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for soaring guitar work ('climbs like an eagle') and engaging stage banter.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned in humorous exchange about Morning Dew; no criticism of his playing.
